title: Process Magic
description: A surreal fantasy scene shows a glowing pink computer mouse held triumphantly by a crowd of masked figures reaching upward. Above them, an intricate tree with roots and branches forms a 'vinyl chain' of floating bubbles containing TikTok logos, hearts, play buttons, and stylized faces, with protest signs reading 'PROCESS MAGIC' visible in the background.
prompt: Surreal vibrant scene of a crowd of masked people with purple cauliflower-like hair reaching their hands up toward a glowing pink computer mouse held high in the center. Above, a large magical tree with roots and branches forms a vinyl chain, its bubbles containing TikTok logos, musical notes, hearts, and stylized faces. Protest signs read PROCESS MAGIC. Psychedelic color palette of purple, pink, teal and yellow with dramatic lighting.
